changes: notes expanded: catalogue date field '1950-55-59' is odd; colophon clearly gives VS 1955

notes: The colophon names no persons. The text is ascribed to the Nīlatantra and no author is given. The era is unspecified ('saṃvat … sāla'), but VS fits the catalogue and the period: VS 1955 = 1898 CE (Vaiśākha falls in April–May 1898). 'roja 7' is the seventh day of the week in Persian-style counting, so Saturday. The catalogue field 'SAM (VS) 1950-55-59' is garbled; the colophon clearly reads 1955.
